cases.jd: We are hiring a Backend Intern. You will build REST APIs in Python with FastAPI, model data in PostgreSQL, and write unit tests with pytest. Docker and Git are part of daily work.
ML Intern: work on model fine-tuning with PyTorch, data pipelines in pandas, experiment tracking in MLflow, and deploy models with FastAPI. NLP experience with spaCy or transformers is a plus.
Full Stack SDE: own features across React, TypeScript and Node.js, backed by MongoDB and Redis, deployed to AWS (ECS, S3, Lambda). We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD and Kubernetes for orchestration.
Data Analyst: strong SQL and Excel, dashboards in Power BI or Tableau, and Python with pandas for analysis. We value statistics fundamentals and A/B testing experience. Looker is a plus.
QA Engineer: own test automation with Selenium and Playwright, API testing with Postman, and Python scripting. Tests run in CI/CD with Jenkins; track work in Jira.
